answer: The design leans on per-epoch sampling audit, split across independent auditors, every claim is re-checked by someone with nothing to gain. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. The signal lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the fable is where a second reviewer recomputes them. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the vine of payment, so volume alone buys nothing.
